title: The introduction leaves the contact's address out: one question, never a guessed address

objects.subject: Arjun, meet Ishaan Mehra (Corvane)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Ishaan Mehra, who runs sales at Corvane and wants to pilot an AI chief of staff with his team this quarter. He asked me to put you two in touch, so write to him when you can.

Introly
